summary: Arun cold-called Pranav at Harborlight Advisory to discuss partnership for outsourced finance leadership firms. Pranav was unreceptive, questioned the call source, and declined interest, stating their processes are already advanced.
key_findings: Prospect explicitly rejected: "I didn't ask for this call, and I'm not interested."
Prospect claims advanced automation: "Our processes are already very automated. We have a fairly advanced setup."
Call source was professional networking outreach programme.

evidence.text: I didn't ask for this call, and I'm not interested. This number is for my work, not for people to sell things to me.
Our processes are already very automated. We have a fairly advanced setup, so I don't think this is something we need.

next_actions: Do not call back. Prospect explicitly declined.
Remove from active call list to avoid repeat contact.
coaching_notes: Arun handled the rejection professionally and was transparent about the cold call nature. Good discipline in disclosing the call source when asked. The prospect's firm (outsourced finance leadership) could be a valid target but this individual does not want contact.
